display.title: Shabbos Shirah: The Song at the Sea and the New Song of Moshiach
display.summary_short: On Shabbos Shirah we hear the Song at the Sea in shul, and the Sages teach that a new song will be sung when we leave the final exile with Moshiach.
display.summary_long: A very short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi reminds children that this Shabbos is Shabbos Shirah, when the Torah reading in shul includes the beautiful song the Bnei Yisroel sang as they left Mitzrayim. The Sages point out that the words 'Az yashir' are in the future tense, hinting that the Jewish people will sing again when they leave the final golus. We all ask Hashem 'Ad masai', how much longer, for we want Moshiach now. Children should be in shul to hear the Shirah, and hope to sing the new song, the song of the final redemption, very soon.
display.lesson: Listen to the Shirah in shul and look forward to the new song we will sing when Moshiach comes.
